BeforeExecuteRequest.description: Asks an interceptor whether a tool call may run.

CancelNotification.description: Cancels a request the sender sent earlier.

args.description: The literal text after the command, or empty.

argName.description: Hint for the command's argument, at most 128 bytes.

defaultValue.description: The answer that has focus initially.

parentId.description: A pending Kit request this dialog serves. Kit cancels the dialog when that request ends.

ConfirmRequest.description: Asks the user a yes-or-no question.

data.description: Structured details. Errors from Kit use ErrorData.

ExecuteCommandRequest.description: Runs a command a user invoked.

ExecuteToolRequest.description: Runs a tool the model called.

text.description: Single-line. An item's segments hold at most 4 KiB of text in total.

pullRequest.description: The branch's pull request; null when there is none or it is not known yet.

GitChangedNotification.description: The working directory's Git state or pull request changed.

HideFooterItemRequest.description: Hides a footer item while the claim lasts.

InitializeRequest.description: Opens the conversation; the plugin answers before sending anything else.

parentId.description: A pending Kit request this dialog serves. Kit cancels the dialog when that request ends.

id.description: Opaque identifier of this generation. Clients see the same identifier on the plugin's toasts, dialogs, footer items, and commands. A replacement generation has a new one.

KitCancelNotification.description: Cancels a request the sender sent earlier.

KitMessage.description: A line Kit writes to a plugin's stdin.

url.description: An absolute http or https URL without credentials.

OpenURLRequest.description: Asks the session's attached clients to open a web page.

PluginMessage.description: A line a plugin writes to stdout.

git.description: Null outside a Git worktree or when Git cannot be inspected safely.

ProjectChangedNotification.description: The session's working directory changed; sent to user plugins only.

checks.description: Summary of the pull request's checks.

RegisterInterceptorRequest.description: Asks Kit to consult the plugin before every tool call.

RegisterToolRequest.description: Registers a tool the model may call.

value.description: Any JSON, at most 16 KiB; null is a valid value.

parentId.description: A pending Kit request this dialog serves. Kit cancels the dialog when that request ends.

SelectRequest.description: Asks the user to choose an option.

SetFooterItemRequest.description: Creates or replaces a footer item.

ShutdownRequest.description: Asks the plugin to stop; it answers null and exits within two seconds.

instructions.description: The subagent's instructions, at most 128 KiB.

model.description: Kit model selector; defaults to the session's model.

idempotencyKey.description: Repeating a key with the same text returns the original result.

text.description: At most 128 KiB; must not be blank or contain NUL.

SubmitMessageRequest.description: Starts a turn in the plugin's idle session.

result.description: The result definition of the request's method.

ToastNotification.description: Shows a notification in the session's clients.

persistent.description: Keep the notification until the user dismisses it.

subtitle.description: At most 4,096 bytes; may contain newlines.

name.description: The model-facing tool name, such as bash or plugin__tool.

message.description: Shown to the model as the call's result. At most 8 KiB.

details.description: Any JSON, at most 64 KiB, kept with the call but not shown to the model.

terminate.description: End the turn after this tool's batch completes.

ToolInputSchema.description: Kit's subset of JSON Schema draft 2020-12. Schemas cannot reference other schemas. At most 1,024 nodes and 16 levels.

label.description: Single-line display label, at most 512 bytes. Defaults to the ID.

TurnCompletedNotification.description: A turn settled; carries its user and assistant text.

UnregisterCommandRequest.description: Removes a command; removing an unknown command succeeds.

UnregisterInterceptorRequest.description: Stops consulting the plugin before tool calls.

UnregisterToolRequest.description: Removes a tool; removing an unknown tool succeeds.

description: JSON-RPC 2.0 messages of Kit plugin protocol version 2, one per line on the plugin's stdin and stdout. Generated from github.com/akonwi/kit/api/pluginprotocol; see docs/plugin-protocol/v2.md.
title: Kit plugin protocol 2

x-kit-errors.meaning: The line is not valid JSON or UTF-8.
The message is not a valid request, including a batch.
Invalid params; the message names the rule broken.
A command or tool failed, or Kit cannot show dialogs (data.reason interactivity_unavailable).
The instance's generation is stopping, stopped, or replaced.
A duplicate contribution, or an idempotency key reused with different text.
A size or count limit was exceeded.
Try again later; data.reason says why.
